title: Elegant German Pork Casserole
description: A cultured and molten solo-dinner German dish featuring lemon zest, en-croute, and dash-friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the pork tenderloin to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon zest, chicken broth, and heavy cream.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Place the cooked pork tenderloin in the center of the pastry rectangle.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water and fold the pastry over the pork to form a tight seal.
Place the casserole on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the top with a little bit of water.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
